description: This file defines a convenience function getEmailAddressWidget for generating email address widgets in the SuiteCRM application, with logic for different views (EditView, QuickCreate, ConvertLead, DetailView). It interacts with the SugarEmailAddress class.

methods.name: getEmailAddressWidget
methods.description: Generates an email address widget suited for the specified view, using the SugarEmailAddress class to render appropriate HTML fragments.
